name: language-id
body: The stable id a frontend declares and the detector matches (go, java, cpp, rust, ts, js, csharp, md, py), used for auto-detection, --id-prefix namespacing of opaque ids, and the lang_switch control record that drives per-record FQN rendering and code-type classification. The Python id is `py` (artifact pyfrontend, accepted extensions .py/.pyi).
